content.description: Diagram showing correct and wrong methods for disconnecting spark plug wires at the boot. The correct method shows pulling on the boot itself, while the wrong method shows pulling on the wire.

items: (a) Disconnect the spark plug wires at the boot. DO NOT pull on the wires.

content.description: Illustration showing a hand holding a spark plug, demonstrating proper handling technique

content.text: (c) Check the gap on the new plugs.
NOTE: When checking the gap of a new plug, bend only the base of the ground electrode. Do not touch the tip. Never attempt to adjust the gap on a used plug.

content.description: Diagram showing hands cleaning or inspecting an air filter element

items: (a) Visually check that the air cleaner element is not excessively dirty, damaged or oily.
(b) Clean the element with compressed air. First blow from the back side thoroughly. Then blow off the front side of the element.

content.text: Replace the air cleaner element with a new one.
